steps.en: OCMS checks that the notice exists
Notice must be at a furnishable processing stage
steps.id: Notice harus ada di stage proses yang boleh di-furnish

steps.en: Suspended or advisory notices are not furnishable
steps.id: Notice yang di-suspend permanen atau advisory tidak furnishable
steps.why_en: Code rejects every active suspension, but its own comment says some codes are allowed.
steps.why_id: Kode menolak semua suspension aktif, padahal komentarnya sendiri menyebut beberapa kode boleh.

steps.en: OCMS rejects the request when the notice is not furnishable
steps.id: OCMS menolak request bila notice tidak furnishable
steps.why_en: One of the two PLUS update paths writes the data without any furnishable check.
steps.why_id: Satu dari dua jalur update PLUS menulis data tanpa cek furnishable sama sekali.
